# TextStyleOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for constructing a [`TextStyle`](text-style.md).

Derived from the class rather than hand-written, so adding a property to `TextStyle` and to `TEXT_STYLE_OPTION_KEYS` carries its JSDoc into autocomplete with no second declaration to keep in step.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type TextStyleOptions = Partial<Omit<Pick<TextStyle, TextStyleOptionKey>, TextStyleWidenedKey>> & {
    /** Font size. Accepts a length: `12`, `'12pt'`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    fontSize?: LengthInput;
    /** Letter spacing (tracking). Accepts a length: `0.4`, `'0.2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    letterSpacing?: LengthInput;
    /** Word spacing. Accepts a length: `1`, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    wordSpacing?: LengthInput;
    /** Decoration line thickness. Accepts a length: `0.75`, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    decorationThickness?: LengthInput;
    /** Baseline shift. Accepts a length: `2`, `'2pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    baselineShift?: LengthInput;
    /** Font weight. Accepts `'bold'`, `'semi-bold'`, … or the numeric value. */
    fontWeight?: FontWeightInput;
    /** Text colour. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-600'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`). */
    color?: ColorInput;
    /** Background highlight colour. Accepts a palette token or hex. */
    backgroundColor?: ColorInput;
    /** Decoration. Accepts one token or a list: `['underline', 'overline']`. */
    decoration?: TextDecorationInput;
    /** Decoration line colour. Accepts a palette token or hex. */
    decorationColor?: ColorInput;
    /** Decoration line style. Accepts `'solid' | 'wavy' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'`. */
    decorationStyle?: DecorationStyleInput;
    /** Baseline alignment. Accepts `'baseline' | 'superscript' | 'subscript'`. */
    baselineAlignment?: BaselineAlignmentInput;
}
```

### `lineHeight`

```typescript
lineHeight?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Line-height multiplier applied to font size. Null = inherit (1.2 if not set anywhere). Set to 1.5 for looser leading or 1.0 for tight leading.
